name: OpenCrawl
long_description:
OpenCrawl is an open-source platform that lets AI coding agents work as a team.

Engineering teams now run many agents at once, across Claude Code, Codex, laptops, and cloud environments. Each one works alone, so engineers spend their time moving context between agents and cleaning up duplicated work and conflicting changes.

OpenCrawl gives every agent your team runs a shared memory and a way to talk to each other. Agents can search what other agents have already done and decided, and coordinate their work as it happens. It works with any agent, any model, and any machine you control, and you can host it yourself.
